.github/workflows/ci.yml:
# Relay CI. The job names are the status checks branch protection requires.
#
# Pinning (ADR-028): every action is pinned to a full commit SHA, with the release it was
# reviewed at in a comment, and every scanner runs from an image pinned by digest. The SHAs and
# digests in this snapshot are lab stand-ins in the right form; Relay's real repository pins the
# reviewed commits. Dependabot proposes updates; a person reviews each one (Chapter 1).
#
# Untrusted input (ADR-029): this workflow runs on pull_request only, with a read-only token and
# no secrets. Nothing here runs on pull_request_target, issue_comment or workflow_run.
name: ci
on: [pull_request, merge_group]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@2222222222222222222222222222222222222222  # v5, stand-in SHA
        with: {python-version: "3.11"}
      - run: python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q
      - run: python tools/lint.py

  supply-chain:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@2222222222222222222222222222222222222222  # v5, stand-in SHA
        with: {python-version: "3.11"}
      - run: python tools/supplychain.py

  # The three scanners of ADR-029, each from a pinned image, each writing SARIF. The gate applies
  # relay-security-gates-v1 (security/gates.json): it fails on a blocking finding, ignores a
  # suppression that is not reviewed, and fails when a scanner report is missing (fail closed).
  # ILLUSTRATIVE: this snapshot does not vendor the scanners or the gate script; Lab 13.1 builds
  # the gate and runs it on simulated scanner output.
  security-gates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - name: SAST (Semgrep, Relay's rules in security/semgrep.yml)
        run: >-
          docker run --rm --network=none -v "$PWD:/src"
          semgrep/semgrep@sha256:3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333
          semgrep scan --config /src/security/semgrep.yml --sarif --output /src/semgrep.sarif /src
      - name: Secrets (gitleaks, full history)
        run: >-
          docker run --rm --network=none -v "$PWD:/repo"
          zricethezav/gitleaks@sha256:4444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444
          git /repo --config /repo/security/gitleaks.toml --report-format sarif --report-path /repo/gitleaks.sarif
      - name: Dependencies and IaC (Trivy; --offline-scan stops lookups in package registries)
        run: >-
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src"
          aquasec/trivy@sha256:5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555
          fs --offline-scan --scanners vuln,misconfig --format sarif --output /src/trivy.sarif /src
      - name: Gate
        run: python tools/security_gate.py --policy security/gates.json --require-reports semgrep.sarif gitleaks.sarif trivy.sarif

  # ILLUSTRATIVE: this snapshot does not vendor the audit package or the policy file,
  # so the job shows the shape of the check rather than running as written. A real job
  # installs the audit tool and fetches the policy from the platform team's repository.
  # It should also read branch protection live from the platform's API, not from the
  # committed export.
  secret-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@2222222222222222222222222222222222222222  # v5, stand-in SHA
        with: {python-version: "3.11"}
      - run: python -m audit.report --policy workspace-policy.json --fail-on high .
